I fixed the new code for all three rules. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **Roles:** `update-user-role.ts` now validates with `z.nativeEnum(ROLES)`. `update-user-role.tsx` builds its options from `ROLES.ADMIN` and `ROLES.USER`, imported from `@/lib/authorization`.
- **Notifications:** `useUpdateUserRole` now calls `useNotifications` and shows the "User Role Updated" toast in its own `onSuccess`. The component no longer imports `useNotifications` or passes an `onSuccess`.
- **Forms:** the raw `<select>` is replaced with `Form` and `Select` from `@/components/ui/form`. The role is submitted when the value changes, so there is still no submit button. The select now renders a visible "Role" label in each row, because `Select` always wraps its field in a labelled wrapper.

I left `src/testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts` alone. It still uses `'ADMIN'` and `'USER'` strings, like the other mock handlers (`auth.ts`, `utils.ts`). I didn't import `ROLES` there because `authorization.tsx` is a React module and the stand-alone mock server may not load it. If you want the handler changed anyway, say so.
